feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 September 2026 7:18am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 14 September 2026 at 7:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind developing later today.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over the near Continent and low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, soon increasing 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this evening, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, then rain spreading from the west this evening, turning heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Very poor in fog patches. Becoming mainly good later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 at times, veering west or northwest overnight into Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then isolated showers developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
